DLC2312:4:t_100:0.en:
$n
「The support and maintenance crews are amazing.」

DLC2312:4:t_100:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But from here, it's the mobile force's job.」

DLC2312:4:t_101:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「How about it, $$ランド$$? Seen what Public Relations Division 2 can really do?」

DLC2312:4:t_101:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah. They're real pros, all right.」

DLC2312:4:t_101:2.en:
$$メール$$
「And they're still doing a perfect job directing the evacuation.」

DLC2312:4:t_101:3.en:
$$いぶき$$
「I knew that sort of thing was their specialty, but...」

DLC2312:4:t_101:4.en:
$$青山$$
「I never expected them to pull off an infiltration, too.」

DLC2312:4:t_101:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「The maintenance crew, too! But we can't let them show us up!」

DLC2312:4:t_101:6.en:
$$赤木$$
「They've passed us the baton! Now we'll carry it to the finish line!!」

DLC2312:4:t_102:0.en:
$$レド$$
（$$エイミー$$ and $$ピニオン$$ are fighting, too...）

DLC2312:4:t_102:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Despite being in combat, Ensign $$レド$$'s body is in a relaxed state.」

DLC2312:4:t_102:2.en:
$$葵$$
「Don't be such a spoilsport, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. $$レド$$'s happy about how well $$エイミー$$'s doing.」

DLC2312:4:t_102:3.en:
$$朔哉$$
「But the operation isn't over yet.」

DLC2312:4:t_102:5.en:
$$レド$$
「Understood. I don't want $$エイミー$$ and the others' hard work to go to waste.」

DLC2312:4:t_102:7.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「The words to say at a time like this are just what I taught you before we launched.」

DLC2312:4:t_102:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. This unit will do it, too.」

DLC2312:4:t_103:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
（I never thought $$チェーン$$ would end up on the front lines...）

DLC2312:4:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
（$$タクヤ$$ and $$ミコット$$ are doing their best, too.）

DLC2312:4:t_103:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Let's go, $$バナージ$$. From here on, it's our job.」

DLC2312:4:t_103:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
（If $$オードリー$$ were with $c, she'd probably have taken part in this operation, too...）

DLC2312:4:t_104:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The support crew really knows what they're doing.」

DLC2312:4:t_104:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Of course! As a member of both the mobile force and support crew, I, $$ノノ$$, guarantee their abilities!」

DLC2312:4:t_104:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「This is a good opportunity, $$ノノ$$. Why don't you transfer to the support crew full-time?」

DLC2312:4:t_104:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Are you telling me I'm fired?!」

DLC2312:4:t_104:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm joking. I'll be counting on you to keep backing me up.」

DLC2312:4:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ノーマン$$ comes through as always.」

DLC2312:4:t_105:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ギャリソン$$'s efficiency never fails to impress me.」

DLC2312:4:t_105:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Our butlers are working so hard. Their masters will have to work even harder.」

DLC2312:4:t_105:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let's do our utmost to live up to their expectations.」

DLC2312:4:t_106:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「$$セイミー$$, $$ルゥ$$, thank you for your hard work!」

DLC2312:4:t_106:1.en:
$$佐伯$$
「Section Chief $$大杉$$, everyone! Leave the rest to us!」

DLC2312:4:t_106:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To repay their valiant efforts, we must make this operation a success...!」

DLC2312:4:t_107:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
（The optimism of Earthlings never ceases to amaze me...）

DLC2312:4:t_107:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
（This planet really does seem to be something special, even in this galaxy.）

review.context: The combat teams acknowledge their support crews' work and resolve to complete the operation. Sardias reflects on Earth's exceptional resilience.
decisions: Nono's Onee-sama address is retained as her established personal address to Lal'C.
Ledo's battle cry is translated as an enthusiastic declaration, with Chamber mechanically echoing it.
